 Foundation Weber WBBL player and current South Australia WNCL captain Jemma Barsby has been named in Sydney Thunder's 13-player squad ahead of tomorrow's clash with Brisbane Heat at Drummoyne Oval.
 If selected, Barsby will make her debut in lime green after missing Thunder's six-wicket victory over the Melbourne Renegades in their WBBL|12 season opener on Thursday due to personal reasons.
 The experienced allrounder replaces Hasrat Gill in the squad, with Thunder looking to build on their winning start to the season in front of a home crowd.
 Meanwhile, Lauren Kua has been added to Thunder's extended 15-player squad as a Local Replacement Player for Claire Moore, who has been sidelined with a finger injury.
 Sydney Thunder Head Coach, Lisa Keightley, said: 
 "It was a great effort by the players in Melbourne and just the way we wanted to start the season.
 "With two left-handers in Brisbane's top five, we've looked closely at the match-ups and believe Jemma's experience and off-spin bowling will give us another valuable option with the ball. 
 "Lauren had a great Spring Challenge and we wanted to replace Claire with a like-for-like talent. We wish Claire a speedy recovery and hope to have her back with us soon."
